stem_book: [One or more options may be correct] A system contains hot water in a sealed, rigid metallic container that is perfectly insulated. Which statements about the system are correct? (a) The system cannot exchange matter with surroundings (b) The system cannot exchange energy with surroundings (c) The system behaves as an isolated system (d) The system boundary is fixed
key: a,b,c,d all four statements are correct
derived: a,b,c,d all four statements are correct
correct_answer: a,b,c,d all four statements are correct
reason: added the implied assumption "rigid" so (d) boundary-is-fixed is unambiguous
work: Sealed -> no matter; perfectly insulated (and rigid, no work) -> no energy -> isolated; rigid wall -> fixed boundary -> a,b,c,d
